terrain_source.warning: Resampled bare-earth lidar; source age and road registration limit accuracy
terrain_source.sampling: 10 m longitudinal, -4/0/+4 m lateral; enclosing local ground triangle, inverse-distance interpolation across unobserved gaps; no plane extrapolation

accuracy.road_plan: OSM observations, four-metre controls; aerial comparison. No centimetre-level survey claim.
accuracy.widths: Aerial/operator dimensional estimates; full per-corner survey unavailable
accuracy.runoff_and_walls: Mapped and aerial-digitized explicit paths; metre-scale image registration and date differences remain
accuracy.elevation: Measured terrain sampled on geographically registered road; 6.5 m Gaussian profile filter; source age and plan alignment limit accuracy
accuracy.banking: Filtered 8 m cross-sections from regional lidar; 14 m longitudinal Gaussian filter; not a kerb-scale engineering survey
accuracy.surroundings: Mapped footprints and attributed vegetation; unmeasured architectural heights and details approximated
accuracy.pit_closures: Fictional physical gates requested by the user
accuracy.unresolved: Start placement was projected and compared visually with the aerial pit straight; the exact painted line remains approximate.
accuracy.elevation_relief: Regional ground lidar relief 43.48 m agrees with Formula 1's published 43 m. Municipal operator separately quotes approximately 56 m. No extrema scaling applied.

architecture_reference.reference_usage: Roof engineer actual construction/detail photos and municipal operator description: elevated pit garages, glazed paddock guardrail, branching metal arches and white tensioned membrane. Official operator lists 23 standard boxes; photographed upper canopy is open-sided. Exact untagged dimensions are authored estimates. Reference photographs not redistributed.

features.evidence: 2019 municipal renovation and roof-engineer construction photos. 23 garage bays under open paddock hospitality canopy, branching steel supports, glass guardrails. Roof height and surface reconstructed from photographs; surveyed ground retained.
